coherence_stylistic.explantion: Both response a and response b are reported to maintain a consistent formal, academic tone, uniform complexity, and third‑person objective voice with no abrupt style shifts or other stylistic issues. consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses suffer from blurred viewpoint/conflation errors, which are the most severe internal consistency failures.
